calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, fade its lagged seven-day return relative to the same-date cross-sectional median, scaled by its lagged 20-day daily-return volatility. All inputs are lagged or available at the decision date; cross-sectional median uses only the available 15 tradable instruments. Signals are undefined where volatility is unavailable or zero.

validation.regime_notes: Daily gate passes over the full 15-instrument universe. Regime IC/ICIR: 2020-22 0.03636/0.10703 (507 dates), 2023-24 0.01980/0.06169 (257 dates), 2025-26 0.03289/0.10512 (505 dates). Small cross-asset cross-sections imply conservative uncertainty interpretation.
